[{"insert":"Barbell Cycling
 
This section trains barbell speed and efficiency once you are already breathing hard. The bike comes first to drive the heart rate up, then you cycle six hang squat snatches without putting the bar down if you can. Three sets with two full minutes of rest means every set should be fast rather than survived. Push the bike a little harder on each set and try to move the bar better each time, not only quicker.
"}]
